message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **official Canadian long weekends** for 2023 (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
(If you’re in a province that has a holiday on a Thursday or Tuesday, you can add a day off to make a 4‑day weekend – see the notes below.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (most provinces) | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✔ | Creates a Fri‑Sat‑Sun long weekend. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | ✖ (holiday on weekend) | Still a public holiday, but no extra day off. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend. |

### Quick Tips for Planning

| Province | Extra Long‑Weekend Opportunities (2023) | How to Make It a 4‑Day Break |
|----------|----------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| **Quebec** | St. Jean‑Baptiste Day (Jun 24, Thursday) | Take Friday off → Thu‑Fri‑Sat‑Sun |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Manitoba** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Nova Scotia** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Prince Edward Island** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already a long weekend. | – |

> **Tip:** If you’re in a province that has a holiday on a Thursday (e.g., St. Jean‑Baptiste Day in Quebec) or a Tuesday (e.g., some provincial holidays), you can simply take the adjacent weekday off to stretch the weekend to four days.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like province‑specific details or a full calendar view!
